conventions.coordinates: RAS mm; arrays indexed [k, j, i]; affine maps (i, j, k, 1) -> RAS
conventions.sheets: deformed_surface_grid(pose, params, n, offset) of the bent-tile fit; offset 0 = seed sheet, -3 mm = tissue face (on the wall), +1 mm = cavity face; offsets taken along the model normal oriented toward the cavity (tile_model_normal_toward_cavity)
conventions.faces: sheet_faces is shared: vertex r*n + c of the row-major n x n grid
conventions.leftover: seed_tile_id == -1 / seed_leftover True: no tile of that mode owns the seed
conventions.modes: auto = count-free pipeline (reconstruct n_full_tiles='auto'); count<N> = count-known pipeline path (reconstruct n_full_tiles=N, chord score, degraded completion); prior<N> = planner path fit_tiles_prior(ImplantPrior(N), mesh)

auto.label: count-free (auto)
auto.summary: evidence supports n=6 (no further tile candidate); 8 seeds unassigned

prior8.label: count-known N=8 (planner, fit_tiles_prior)
prior8.summary: asked for 8 full tile(s): 7 supported (geometry supports only 7); 4 seeds unassigned

seed_centers_ras.doc: detected seed centres (shape-filtered, vault-filtered candidates), RAS

seed_axes_ras.doc: per-seed PCA long axis (sign arbitrary), RAS

cavity_center_ras.doc: centroid of the gtcore cavity mask (nan when none): tile normals point away from it

volume_spacing_mm.doc: voxel spacing (si, sj, sk) of the CT

sheet_faces.doc: triangles shared by every *_sheet_*_vertices array (row-major n x n grid, sheet_grid_n)

sheet_grid_n.doc: grid points per tile side in the sheets

seed_elongation.doc: sqrt(major/minor) PCA eigenvalue ratio of the blob

wall_mesh_vertices.doc: the mesh the fits conformed to (planner rule: gtcore cavity, else the scanned object's shell), RAS

cavity_rt_vertices.doc: physician's Cav_Post from the RTSTRUCT, rasterised on the CT grid (4x4 supersampled, >= 0.5) and marching-cubed (Taubin-smoothed), RAS

auto_tile_id.doc: [mode auto] tile id within the mode

auto_tile_confidence.doc: [mode auto] 'supported' (calibrated gates / model selection) or 'tentative' (cover pass)

auto_tile_degraded.doc: [mode auto] recovered outside the standard gates (crumpled / folded; loose tier or count completion)

auto_tile_seed_indices.doc: [mode auto] member seeds (into seed_centers_ras), -1 padded; a triplet-completed tile has 3

auto_tile_inferred_seed_ras.doc: [mode auto] the inferred 4th seed of a triplet-completed tile, nan otherwise

auto_tile_center_ras.doc: [mode auto] mean of the member seeds

auto_tile_normal_ras.doc: [mode auto] fit.py pose normal: away from the cavity centre when one was given

auto_tile_axis_ras.doc: [mode auto] in-plane tile axis t1 (along the seed axes)

auto_tile_chord_residual_mm.doc: [mode auto] RMS chord deviation from the ideal grid (chord score path)

auto_tile_bent_rms_mm.doc: [mode auto] seed-position RMS of the bent-tile fit (gtcore.tiles.deform.fit_deformable)

auto_tile_bending_energy.doc: [mode auto] kappa1^2 + kappa2^2 of the bent-tile fit

auto_tile_fold_deg.doc: [mode auto] total bend angle across the 20 mm tile in the stiffer direction

auto_tile_axis_err_deg.doc: [mode auto] mean angle between observed seed axes and the fitted sheet tangent

auto_tile_model_normal_toward_cavity.doc: [mode auto] bent-tile model normal, sign fixed to point toward the cavity (to_placed_tiles rule)

auto_sheet_seed_vertices.doc: [mode auto] deformed quad surface through the seeds (bent-tile model, offset 0), row-major n x n, RAS

auto_sheet_tissue_vertices.doc: [mode auto] the same sheet 3 mm toward the wall (tissue face of the tile)

auto_sheet_cavity_vertices.doc: [mode auto] the same sheet 1 mm toward the cavity (cavity face of the 4 mm tile)

auto_sheet_corners_tissue_ras.doc: [mode auto] the 4 collagen corners on the tissue face (loop order)
